stem: Based on the information throughout the selection, what can the reader conclude about students who listen to music during a test?

options.label: F
options.text: Students will likely fall asleep during a test if there is music playing.

options.label: G
options.text: Students will get their blood pumping if they listen to music during a test.

options.label: H
options.text: Students will be less bored if they are able to listen to music during a test.

options.label: J
options.text: Students will feel calmer during a test if there is music playing.
